markets.name: Belpre Farmers Market
markets.about: Local market for local producers. Sunday afternoons, noon-3, on a riverfront farm with live music and access by boat on the Ohio River with great views.

markets.name: River City Farmers Market

markets.name: Ridge Runner Farmers Market
markets.street: 432 New England Ridge Road, Washington, WV, USA
markets.about: We are a new Farmers Market featuring vendors who offer a variety of seasonal produce grown on site, locally made, value added food products, wholesale beef and pork, farm eggs, and hand-crafted items.
